report.summary: 1 action-required finding: the checkout service now sends Confidential order data to an external analytics collector absent from the DFD and third-party dependency model.

findings.title: Confidential order data now flows to an unmodeled analytics service

evidence.note: Defines a hosted external analytics collector URL.
Begins serialization of an order analytics event.
Includes the customer's email, which belongs to the Confidential order-history asset.
Includes the order amount in the outbound payload.
Posts the serialized order data to the external analytics service.
Publishes analytics after each successful order insertion.

relevance.justification: The checkout DFD models only Customer, Web App, and Orders Database, while the changed code introduces a direct outbound flow of Confidential order data to a new hosted external service.

findings.agent_prompt: Update app.tm.hcl in data_flow_diagram_v2 "checkout" to model the new hosted analytics integration: add an external element for collector.example-analytics.com and a flow from "Web App" to that element carrying the Confidential "order-history" asset. Also add a third-party dependency assertion for the hosted analytics service. This is required because internal/orders/analytics.go:9 defines the external collector, lines 13-17 serialize order ID, customer email, and amount, line 22 sends them via HTTP, and internal/orders/orders.go:8 invokes this for every created order.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the analytics collector as a third-party dependency and DFD external element, with a Web App-to-collector flow carrying the order-history asset.
